text: background_fetch needs minSdkVersion 21 because its backbone, Android JobScheduler, only exists from API 21.
Version solving failed in pubspec.yaml is a proof, not a bug. Read the 'because' chain bottom-up to find the one impossible constraint.
RenderFlex overflowed in Flutter? Wrap the greedy child in Expanded. The stripe is an unbounded-child bug, not paint.
Claude tool schema mismatch is two different bugs. Top-level anyOf gets a 400. Runtime input drift needs a retry loop.
XA1029 in MAUI Android is a wrapper. Scroll up: the real Gradle error is JDK 11 vs 17, missing maui-android workload, or Windows long paths.
dotnet ef has no --command-timeout flag in EF Core 11. The 30s default lives on the design-time DbContext. Set CommandTimeout on UseSqlServer or put it in the connection string.
CS0246 right after a new ProjectReference? Look at NU1201 above it. TargetFramework mismatch is the bug; the C# error is the symptom.
Cursor for the plan, Aider for the diffs. Export the chat to markdown and pass it to Aider as --read.
HttpClient throws TaskCanceledException for three different reasons. Check ex.InnerException is TimeoutException before you raise any timeout.
Stop pasting team conventions into Copilot Chat. A SKILL.md in .github/skills loads only when the prompt matches.
Flutter M3 has no accentColor. ColorScheme.fromSeed is the one knob. Pick fidelity if your brand must render literally.
await is not parallelism. Isolate.run for one-shot CPU work, Isolate.spawn for warm workers. On web, neither runs.
MAUI 11 drag-and-drop in one line: DataPackage.Properties is process-local. Set e.Data.Text too if the drop crosses apps.
MAUI dark mode that actually flips: AppThemeBinding plus ConfigChanges.UiMode on MainActivity. Without the flag, Android only switches once.
Cursor just shipped a TypeScript SDK. Same Composer agent as the editor, runs against your cwd or a sandboxed cloud VM.
MAUI to the Microsoft Store: dotnet publish per arch, MakeAppx bundle, zip as .msixupload. The VS wizard still won't.
byte[] to ReadOnlyMemory<byte> in .NET 11: implicit cast for the full array, AsMemory(start, length) for a slice.
One Flutter repo, many SDK versions in CI: .fvmrc as truth, a fail-fast:false matrix on subosito/flutter-action v2.
Claude Code 2.1.128: --plugin-dir takes .zip archives, EnterWorktree branches from local HEAD, OTEL_* no longer leaks to subprocesses.
GetConnectionString returns null in .NET 11? Usually appsettings.json key missing or not copied to bin, not your code.
Expose EF Core to a coding agent via MCP, not a RunQuery(sql) tool. IDbContextFactory, AsNoTracking, gated writes.
Skip the federated plugin scaffold. A MethodChannel plus 20 lines in MainActivity / AppDelegate is the whole bridge.
Agent Framework 1.0: wrap an AIFunction in ApprovalRequiredAIFunction and the agent pauses for a human first.
Migrating Flutter from GetX to Riverpod 3.x: GetxController to Notifier, .obs to providers, Get.find to ref.watch.
Semantic Kernel 1.75 in a BackgroundService: scope per tick, or your scoped DbContext disposes mid-loop.
Flutter jank: profile mode, real device, Frame Analysis. Red on UI = your Dart code. Red on raster = shaders or saveLayer.
Agent Framework workflows now checkpoint per executor. Microsoft.Agents.AI.DurableTask + Azure Functions = restart-safe runs.
ListView to CollectionView in MAUI 11: no CachingStrategy, RefreshView wraps it, SwipeView replaces ContextActions.
EF Core's 'another instance with the same key value is already being tracked' usually means your DbContext is Singleton.
EF Core 'second operation was started on this context' means two awaits raced one DbContext. Fix: IDbContextFactory.
Copilot Studio's WASM engine moved to .NET 10: ~20% faster cold path, ~5% warm, +15% package. Why the tradeoff is worth it.
Keep Playwright's 25 browser_* tools out of your main Claude Code session. One subagent owns them, parent stays lean.
System.Text.Json only takes ISO 8601 for DateTime. Send 2026-05-08T14:00:00Z or register a JsonConverter.
Copilot dropped claude-sonnet-4 May 6 across all surfaces. Move pinned configs to claude-sonnet-4-6.
Unable to resolve service for type 'X' in ASP.NET Core: read X first, Y second. Three fixes cover almost every case.
Scope validation caught a captive: a singleton just grabbed your scoped DbContext. IServiceScopeFactory fixes it.
Native AOT has no JIT, so Reflection.Emit and Expression.Compile throw at runtime. IL3050 names the call to swap.
Cursor 3.3: async subagents run independent plan steps in parallel. Split PRs slices one chat into many.
Tests prove the code runs, not that the agent passed by deleting the assertion. Rubric + Sonnet 4.6 judge, in Python.
MSB3027 means MSBuild gave up after 10 copy retries. Something held bin/MyApp.dll open. Use handle.exe to find it.
'Unable to create an object of type DbContext'? EF Core's host probe needs app.Run() to be the last statement in Program.cs.
Cursor Bugbot adds effort levels. Default = 0.7 bugs/PR, High = 0.95. Custom routes via a plain-English rule.
RZ10012 in Blazor: build passes, but the tag renders as raw HTML. Add @using to _Imports.razor.
cache_control on the system prompt is the easy part. Rolling breakpoints so a 50-turn agent loop pays the prefix once.
Kestrel throws on Stream.Read of the request body. await ReadAsync fixes it. AllowSynchronousIO=true is the trapdoor.
'Possible object cycle' on an EF Core entity? IgnoreCycles is one line. The DTO is the real fix.
Claude Code grep stops scaling around 200k LOC. Attach a hybrid BM25 + dense MCP server and recall jumps.
Process.RunAndCaptureTextAsync in .NET 11: stdout and stderr in one call. Bye OutputDataReceived.
MCP server stuck on 'connecting' in Claude Code is almost always stdout pollution. One console.log breaks JSON-RPC.
Flutter 3.44 freezes Material and Cupertino in the SDK. material_ui and cupertino_ui take over on pub.dev. SwiftPM is the new default.
'Provisioning profile doesn't include the currently selected device' in MAUI iOS = the UDID isn't in the profile yet.
MAUI iOS build dies on 'no valid iOS Simulator runtime'? Xcode 15+ unbundled them. xcodebuild -downloadPlatform iOS.
dotnet new mcpserver no longer needs Microsoft.McpServer.ProjectTemplates. .NET 11 Preview 4 bundles it in the SDK.
FormatException at character 1 in Dart? It's a 404 HTML page, a UTF-8 BOM, or latin-1 decode. Not your JSON.
Aider died mid-refactor on a token limit? It's almost never the model. /clear, /drop, cap --map-tokens 1024.
Flutter Failed to build iOS app on Xcode 16? Bump Flutter to 3.24.4+, raise Podfile to iOS 13, wipe Pods plus DerivedData.
GPT-5.3-Codex is now the default Copilot model on Business and Enterprise. GPT-4.1 stays free until June 1.
AndroidX conflict in Flutter Android? Flip useAndroidX and enableJetifier in gradle.properties, then audit deps.
429 rate_limit_error on claude-sonnet-4-6 in a long loop is almost always ITPM, not RPM. Cache the system prompt.
framework_version=6.0.0 not found means the .NET 6 runtime is gone, not your app. Four ranked fixes.
Firebase shipped experimental Dart for Cloud Functions. AOT to Cloud Run, ~10ms cold start, HTTPS and callable only.
C# 14 lets T[] convert to Span<T>. array.Contains in Expression trees now throws at runtime. Cast to IEnumerable<int> to fix.
'MCP server disconnected' under WSL is almost never the server. It's npx.cmd, NAT loopback, or VMMem reaping.
net10.0 SDK turns on NuGet package pruning by default. 70% fewer phantom transitive CVEs. NU1510 flags redundant direct refs.
async void is for event handlers. async Task is for everything else. The keyword swap that turns a crash into a catch.
Cursor Apply does nothing on a big file? Fast Apply is a separate model with its own ceiling, not your chat model.
Default to class. record for value-equal data. readonly record struct for small immutable values in hot loops.
Bulk inserts in .NET 11: SqlBulkCopy is 3x faster than EF Core and 15x faster than Dapper at 1M rows. Code inside.
Cursor 3.4 cloud agents span multiple repos per environment, plus Docker build secrets and 70% faster rebuilds.
Returning IQueryable from a service makes every caller a SQL author. Materialize at the boundary.
Copilot ignoring copilot-instructions.md? Put a sentinel at top, ask Chat for it. Rules out half the reported bugs.
ConfigureAwait(false) is a no-op in .NET 11 ASP.NET Core. In any library that ships to UI apps, it's still mandatory.
Minimal APIs in .NET 11 closed the gap with controllers. Pick controllers only for Razor views or big MVC codebases.
C# 16 turns unsafe into a caller contract: callers must wrap your API in unsafe { }, inner blocks now mandatory.
Native AOT starts 3x faster but has no Dynamic PGO. JIT wins steady-state throughput; R2R splits the difference.
ECONNREFUSED ::1 from an MCP client? localhost resolved to IPv6, server bound IPv4. Bind :: or use 127.0.0.1.
On .NET 11, System.Text.Json is in-box, ~2x faster, and the only JSON library that runs under Native AOT.
